claims.text: Apple's iOS 18 added RCS support, so iPhone users now receive RCS messages from Android senders instead of falling back to legacy SMS
A verified RCS business sender profile shows the business name, logo, and a verification badge instead of an anonymous number
An unbranded, unrecognized-number text reads as less trustworthy and is more likely to be ignored
Black Arrow offers a free check of response speed and follow-up setup via DM
